contest.measure_text: SAN MARINO SERVICE PRESERVATION MEASURE. To maintain existing funding which supports essential San Marino services including: police, fire, paramedic, emergency preparedness, repairing streets and sidewalks and other City infrastructure, providing youth and senior programs, and general government use; shall the City of San Marino measure be adopted extending the currently existing utility users tax at a rate of 6 percent, raising $2,620,000 annually, until ended by voters? Supporters: Mayor Chou; Vice Mayor Lo; Council Member Shepherd Romey; Council Member Chang; Council Member Chou Opponents: None submitted.
